messages:
ashwin: Quick announcement — Private v2 is GA for new Dedicated/VPC customers as of today. Key points: 1) SLA: 99.9% site-availability for reserved capacity customers, 2) Data retention default is 30 days (per-customer override available), 3) KMS/HSM integration is GA, 4) onboarding windows and professional services slots are open this quarter. Please read below and action. :rocket:
jen: Awesome — congrats team! Do we have the CSM email template + FAQ ready? Need to start outreach today.
ashwin: Yes. CSM template & FAQ live in the rollout doc: https://go.redwood/internal/private-v2-rollout (internal). Use the "GA outreach" section. Target send by EOD.
devon: Ops/eng notes — API change for retention: new header X-Redwood-Retention-Days or project-level setting. Example curl to set retention and attach KMS key:
```bash
curl -X POST https://private.redwood/api/v1/projects/123/settings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"retention_days":30, "kms_key_id":"projects/xyz/keys/abc"}'
```
maria: Security checklist: a few items for SOC2/reg compliance customers — ensure audit logs retention options included, key rotation docs, and confirmation that HSM-backed keys never leave customer control. I'll attach a short checklist to the rollout doc.
phil: Legal: update required to Data Processing Addendum (DPA) for the default retention and KMS language. Can we get a copy of the customer-facing opt-in language?
ashwin: @phil added. I'll paste the proposed paragraph in the doc by noon. We should coordinate deadline: aim to update DPA and get legal sign-off by next Wed 1782160000 (internal deadline).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: private-v2: rollout/v2 -> prod completed on host-pool-7 (1782102800) :white_check_mark:
jen: For GTM: we need a short bulletin for customers who are already on Private v1 about migration path, compatibility, and any action needed. Can eng produce a migration guide snippet?
devon: Migration notes: v1 projects are compatible but require a settings PR to opt in (retention/kms). We'll add migration snippet to the doc and a one-click toggle in console next week.
ashwin: Action items summary: 1) CSM outreach template (jen) — send by EOD, 2) DPA language (phil + ashwin) — draft by noon, 3) Security checklist (maria) — attach by EOD, 4) Migration guide (devon) — snippet in doc + console toggle ETA next week, 5) Bookings: PS/onboarding slots open, contact @csm-bot to schedule.
csm-bot: PS-bot: New onboarding slots available this week: Tue 10:00-12:00, Wed 14:00-16:00. Use /book-private-onboarding <customer> to reserve.
phil: Noted. I'll start DPA edits today. Ping me if there are customer-specific clauses.
maria: One request — can we set a flag so regulated customers default to 0-day analytics retention while still allowing model logs to be kept for debugging under strict access? I'll put language in the checklist.
devon: We can add a tenant config boolean "strict_data_retention": true that sets analytics_retention=0 by default. Will expose in API.
jen: Great. After CSM outreach I'll publish a short KB article and references in the console help bubble.
ashwin: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks your items, reply here. We'll run a 15-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT with GTM + Security + Legal + Eng to confirm rollout messaging.
jen: Got it — accepted the calendar invite.
ops-bot: incident-bot: no incidents reported in rollout window.
ashwin: Closing note — appreciate the quick turn. This release moves Private into full production posture; keep an eye on the Console dashboards for noisy customers or latency regressions and tag me if anything looks off. :party_popper:
